macros.name: lraskfilename
macros.doc: The command \lraskfilename asks for the data file name from the terminal.

macros.name: lrcomputation
macros.doc: The macro \lrcomputation reads the data and performs all the computations.

macros.name: lrfilename
macros.doc: The command \lrfilename records the file name passed as argument.

macros.name: lrnumdigit
macros.doc: The computed numbers are printed with four decimal digit maximum by default, but this number can be set to any desired \lrnumdigit value with the command \lrnumdigit{⟨number⟩}.

macros.name: lrplot
macros.doc: The macro \lrplot{⟨imagewidth⟩}{⟨key1⟩}{⟨key2⟩}{⟨key3⟩}{⟨key4⟩} really generates the plot.

macros.name: lrplotparameters
macros.doc: The command \lrplotparameters{⟨diameter⟩}{⟨imageheight⟩} is used to record some more parameters that are related to the generation of the plot.

macros.name: lrprint
macros.doc: The macro \lrprint generates a table with all the estimated parameters and some information about the data.
